verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents APIs for programmatically managing connections, transformations and libraries, plus audit-log and usage-metric APIs and an HTTP event API. Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML, and the open-source edition self-hosts on PostgreSQL. Together these make headless, scripted automation plausible, but nothing in the pack explicitly describes CI pipelines or a headless CLI workflow. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or headless runner, explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g. deploying transformations or tracking plans from a pipeline), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
